speaker: Patient
text: Denies nausea, vomiting, diarrhea. No recent travel or sick contacts. No changes in hearing. Denies neck stiffness or photophobia. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I am aware of your previous consultation regarding tuberculosis, but your specific symptoms of progressive vision loss and headache over three weeks point more strongly toward an intracranial mass or optic pathway compression. Given the MRI request I just made, can you describe exactly how your vision has changed—for example, do you see double, or is there a dark shadow in your vision?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pituitary Adenoma
